2609.22000.title: RecreationWorld: Scalable and Verifiable Environments for Hybrid Computer-Use Agents
2609.22000.paper_summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) have advanced along two separate lines: graphical interaction and software development through code and the command line. Real digital work requires both, interleaved rather than stacked end to end. We study hybrid CUAs that autonomously decide when to explore an interface, implement software, and run and visually verify their artifacts. We introduce RecreationWorld, a five-platform framework built around recreation: given a running reference, an agent must discover its behavior and build a faithful implementation with no prescribed workflow. RecreationWorld provides reproducible environments on Ubuntu, macOS, Windows, Android, and Web, plus a unified harness with native GUI control and coding tools. The running reference serves as an oracle for hidden behavioral tests, providing execution-grounded rewards. We scale trajectory generation with high-quality open-source applications. Models trained on these trajectories improve across five out-of-distribution coding and hybrid computer-use benchmarks and more frequently verify their rendered outputs, providing evidence of transfer beyond recreation. For held-out evaluation, we introduce RecreationBench, comprising 250 diverse tasks across domains and platforms. Reference-grounded programmatic and visual assertions cover action-conditioned outcomes at multiple interaction depths; each is validated on the reference and by human reviewers before the suite is frozen for automatic scoring. GPT-6 Astra leads at 58.1% overall, but passes all programmatic tests on just 2.8% of tasks. Agents reproduce static interface structure more reliably than interactions and computed outputs, while generated applications remain smaller and more monolithic than their references. We release the benchmark, environments, and test suites.
2609.22000.paper_summary_zh: 電腦使用代理（CUAs）沿著兩條獨立的路線發展：圖形互動和通過代碼及命令行進行軟體開發。真正的數位工作需要這兩者交錯進行，而不是端對端地堆疊。我們研究能夠自主決定何時探索介面的混合CUAs，實施軟體，並運行和視覺驗證其產物。我們介紹RecreationWorld，一個圍繞娛樂構建的五平台框架：給定一個正在運行的參考，代理必須發現其行為並建立一個忠實的實現，沒有預設的工作流程。RecreationWorld在Ubuntu、macOS、Windows、Android和Web上提供可重現的環境，並配備一個統一的框架，具有本地GUI控制和編碼工具。運行參考作為隱藏行為測試的神諭，提供基於執行的獎勵。我們通過高品質的開源應用程序擴展軌跡生成。基於這些軌跡訓練的模型在五個超出分佈的編碼和混合電腦使用基準上表現改善，並更頻繁地驗證其渲染輸出，提供超越娛樂的轉移證據。對於保留的評估，我們介紹RecreationBench，包含250個跨領域和平台的多樣任務。基於參考的程式性和視覺斷言涵蓋多個互動深度的行動條件結果；每個在參考上和由人類審核者驗證後，該套件才會凍結以進行自動計分。GPT-6 Astra在總體上以58.1%的表現領先，但在僅2.8%的任務上通過所有程式性測試。代理在靜態介面結構的重現上比互動和計算輸出更可靠，而生成的應用程序仍然比其參考更小且更單一。我們發布了基準、環境和測試套件。
